chairs.action: Holding projects a nadir of 84 mmHg. Minimum effective action: taper UF by 35% now — projected nadir 91 mmHg, leaving 1.49 L behind. If systolic reaches 90 anyway, give 250 mL (RN) and escalate to the remote nephrologist. If an episode happens anyway: feet up, recheck BP every 5 min, and a standing BP before discharge — the walk out is a fall risk.
